risks.risk: Wrong model/identity (seller text says Brother SE630, but photos don’t show SE630; brand claim conflicts).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/nameplate (usually on the side/back/bottom) showing 'SE630' (or exact model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic computerized sewing/embroidery machine with unknown model (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Missing key parts (power cable, foot pedal, embroidery hoops/frames, bobbins, needles, manuals). Photos don’t show what’s included.
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out (power cable, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, hoops/frames, manual/CD/USB if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: assume missing items reduce usability).

risks.risk: Condition/working status (no demonstration; computerized machines may have faults).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, LCD working, and a test stitch/embroidery run (with sound and movement).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs service).

risks.risk: Screen/controls and mechanical alignment (LCD may be functional but buttons/tension/feeding may be faulty).
risks.proof: Video close-up of button presses + a straight stitch test with visible fabric feed and even stitches.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model label/nameplate showing the exact model (e.g., SE630) on the machine.
Photos of all included accessories: power cable, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, embroidery hoop/frame(s), and any manual/USB.
Short working video: power on + LCD menu + one test stitch and one embroidery pattern run.
response.reason: The photos show a Brother-branded computerized sewing/embroidery machine, but the seller’s Singer claim and the specific SE630 model claim are not verifiable from the images. Without a readable model label and proof of working condition/accessories, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
